```plato
    // The point of grid cell (i, j, k), jittered from the cell center.
    JitteredCellPoint3D(region: Bounds3D, cellCounts: IntegerVector3, jitter: Number,
        seed: Integer, i: Integer, j: Integer, k: Integer): Point3D
    {
        var o = FeatureOffset3D(seed, i, j, k, jitter);
        return Point3D(
            region.Min.X + (i.ToNumber + o.X) * (region.Max.X - region.Min.X) / cellCounts.X.ToNumber,
            region.Min.Y + (j.ToNumber + o.Y) * (region.Max.Y - region.Min.Y) / cellCounts.Y.ToNumber,
            region.Min.Z + (k.ToNumber + o.Z) * (region.Max.Z - region.Min.Z) / cellCounts.Z.ToNumber);
    }
```
